correctness.rationale: A backwards dependency path must have strictly decreasing clocks; reaching arbitrarily far on either half-line has probability zero by the factorial bound. Condition on the attempt time at the central site: its exterior half-lines are independent until that attempt. Conditioning instead on the first neighbor's clock yields h_A=1−q∫h_B and h_B=1−p∫h_A, with the stated solutions and one-site acceptance probabilities. Conditional on the two prescribed labels being A, the edge can be deleted without changing either endpoint's acceptance: each endpoint blocks only B, not A, and before each endpoint attempts its exterior cannot depend on its own state. The resulting half-line acceptance events have disjoint clocks and labels, giving a² and likewise b². Accepted unlike species cannot neighbor. Reflection, marginals and R_A+R_B=a+b−ab (by differentiation from t=0) then give all remaining entries. For 00 and h_B≥1−pu>0, and each is strictly less than one for u>0; thus R_A
